name: The keepers of a broken promise
summary: The broken scepter did not pass out of history. Its pieces remained in the keeping of dragons, yet the long vigil brought troubles of its own. When Anachronos later named Eranikus, Vaelastrasz and Azuregos, his warning carried the weight of disappointed trust. Each guardian's story had turned toward tragedy or estrangement. To restore the key, mortal seekers would have to enter those stories. A thousand years separated the wars, but time had not protected the watchers from the wounds of the world.
